claim_boundary: The comparison and tests are internal development evidence. They do not support AGI or user-level completion.

comparison_verdict.falsifier: Reject after three matched units if median invocations or wall time do not improve, replay selection is unstable, or protected regressions or side-effect failures worsen.

comparison_verdict.reason: The baseline demonstrates broader parallel hypothesis search and best-checkpoint inheritance, while O demonstrates stronger single-writer, immutable-replay, protected-regression, and claim boundaries. Unmatched tasks, several-hour and provider/GPU cost, manual filtering, and a one-of-three workshop result prevent an adoption claim.
comparison_verdict.rollback: Keep the experiment behind an inactive scoped Candidate and retain the single-lineage path.
